title: In game: is the Battle Shout cast seen in combat (UNIT_SPELLCAST_SUCCEEDED spellID readable)?
description: The combat-only card relies on the cast event's spell ID while buffs are hidden. If Forever makes it secret, a shout in the fight isn't seen and the card stays up until combat ends. Check on a warrior: shout mid-fight, does the card go?

title: Check Ragebound's IDs and rules on Forever in game; take /rage shots
description: Battle Shout ranks, rage cost and duration (2 min assumed), First Aid rank IDs (3273/3274/7924/10846), stone and bandage IDs, fist weapons as sharp, icon fallbacks: Classic values, unchecked on Forever. Then /rage shots for the docs.

title: Verify weapon stone card from LibBound 40 in game
Battle Shout card only in combat, with cast restart and rage glow
Bandage card title is cut off: 'Bandages running lo...'
description: Seen in /rage shots (frames/bdpoint.png): the card title 'Bandages running low' doesn't fit the card width and ends in '...'. Shorten the title (e.g. 'Low on bandages') or let the card fit it.

title: Ragebound text gaps: unlock shows the stone card when off; 'any bandage counts' means cloth bandages only
description: Unlocking frames shows the weapon stone card even with the feature off. Options/Bandages.lua say any bandage counts, but only the 10 cloth bandages are counted (no Anti-Venom or battleground bandages). Found by the docs pass.

title: Ragebound: Battle Shout 'gone' reminder may be noisy for a warrior without rage
description: battleShoutKeep is on by default like the siblings; out of combat the warrior often has no rage to recast. Decide the default after in-game use.
